_description: Area inputs of the 64 x 64 1F1C config (one array: 64 data columns and ISAAC's unit column, each with its column readout) that are not in design.json, each with its source in _provenance. The cell array area is not here: it is results/nvsim.json -> array.array_area_um2 (28 nm). The 7-bit ADC and its front end are the default's (../default/area.json).

_provenance.adc.per_array: One buffer, sample-and-hold and SAR ADC per column (Laleni et al. 2024, Fig. 9, Sec. IV): 64 data columns + 1 unit column (design.json encoding)
_provenance.adc.bits, source_bits: design.json adc.bits (7, ISAAC Eq. 2 with the weight-flip encoding); the source ADC (CAP-RAM) is 7-bit, so its area is used as is. An ADC of more bits than the source scales its area by 2^(bits - source_bits): ISAAC Sec. III, 'some ADC overheads grow exponentially with resolution', and our SAR keeps its unit capacitor, so its capacitive DAC doubles per bit (spice/adc/sar_full_tb_8b.sp)
_provenance.adc.source_area_um2, source_node_nm, dee: As ../default/area.json: CAP-RAM (Chen et al., IEEE JSSC, arXiv 2107.02388), Sec. III-B, per-column 7-bit ciSAR ADC, 429 um^2 in 65-nm LP CMOS; DeepScaleTool area factor 65 -> 28 nm
_provenance.column_frontend: The default's front end (spice/adc/sar_full_tb.sp: buffer_ab CC=70f, N2=4, N6=6, CLS=200f; bootsw CB=25f, WS=500n), unchanged since the 7-bit ADC is the default's; area per column and transistor list as ../default/area.json _provenance
